recipes.name: Taco Night
recipes.description:
1. Brown the ground beef with the diced onion over medium heat, 8-10 min.
  2. Stir in taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water; simmer 5 min.
  3. Warm the tortillas.
  4. Serve with shredded lettuce, diced tomato and cheddar.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Marinara
recipes.description:
1. Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
  2. Saute garlic in olive oil, 1 min.
  3. Add crushed tomatoes and basil; simmer 15 min.
  4. Toss with pasta and finish with parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description:
1. Cook the rice.
  2. Slice and sear the chicken in a hot pan, 6-8 min.
  3. Add broccoli, bell pepper, garlic and ginger; stir-fry 4 min.
  4. Add soy sauce, toss, and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Weekend Pancakes
recipes.description:
1. Whisk flour, egg, milk and melted butter into a smooth batter.
  2. Rest 10 min.
  3. Fry on a buttered griddle until bubbles set, flip.

recipes.name: Korean Short Rib Ramen
recipes.description:
1. Cut the slab into individual ribs. Season heavily with salt on all sides; rest ~1 hour.
  2. Heat BBQ to high. Grill ribs over direct heat until deeply browned on all sides; set aside.
  3. Set BBQ for indirect cooking. Place the braising pan on the off-heat side and heat.
  4. Add beef tallow. Sear garlic, ginger, and scallion whites until fragrant. Add halved onions cut-side down.
  5. Add Korean chili flakes and gochujang; work gochujang in with a brush until it toasts. Add sugar.
  6. Return ribs. Add soy sauce, star anise, cinnamon, and pear. Add stock to the level of the ribs. Braise over indirect heat ~6 hours until meat pulls easily.
  7. Pull meat from bones; discard bones. Skim fat if desired. Finish with sesame oil and scallions.
  8. Blanch wonton noodles, rinse under cold water, toss with a little sesame oil.
  9. Place noodles in a bowl, ladle over meat and braising liquid, garnish with scallions.
  10. Stovetop option: sear ribs in neutral oil, then braise in a 250F oven 4-6 hours.

recipes.name: Japanese Pickled Cucumber
recipes.description:
1. Heat white wine to cook off the alcohol; let cool.
  2. Sprinkle cucumbers with salt, rub on a cutting board, rinse, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Slice chili peppers.
  3. Place seasonings, cucumbers, and chili pepper in a ziplock bag; massage well.
  4. Marinate in the refrigerator 30 minutes, then serve.

recipes.name: Steak Marinade
recipes.description:
1. Combine 1 part soy, 1 part pineapple juice, 1/4 part water — enough liquid to submerge the meat.
  2. Marinate 20 minutes maximum.

recipes.name: Chile Relleno Dip
recipes.description:
1. Preheat oven to 375F. In a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium-high, cook chorizo, breaking into crumbles, 6-8 min. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined bowl. Wipe skillet; do not wash.
  2. Stir together cream cheese, mayo, sour cream, Cotija, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and 1/2 cup cheddar. Stir in chiles, cilantro, and chorizo. Spread in the reserved skillet.
  3. Stir together panko, brown sugar, and remaining 1/4 cup cheddar. Sprinkle over the dip.
  4. Bake 20-25 min until hot and golden. Garnish with Cotija and cilantro; serve with corn chips.

recipes.name: Beef Stir Fry
recipes.description:
1. Cut thin slices of beef.
  2. Coat beef in light+dark soy, cornstarch, bicarb, sugar, and 1 Tbsp oil; rest 10-30 min.
  3. Cut all other ingredients to size.
  4. Cook rice noodles per packet, rinse.
  5. Fry beef in a wok on high heat with a little oil; set aside once browned.
  6. Add remaining stir-fry ingredients; cook 2 min.
  7. Add the noodles.
  8. Mix sauces (dark+light soy, oyster, sesame oil, sugar, lemon) in a bowl, add to the wok, coat noodles until browned.
  9. Return beef; cook 2 min. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Korean Popcorn Chicken
recipes.description:
1. Marinate chicken in soy sauce, egg, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
  2. Coat in potato starch; fry until crisp and golden.
  3. Make the sauce: gochujang, brown sugar, honey, rice vinegar, ketchup, sesame oil, garlic, butter — simmer.
  4. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce and serve.

recipes.name: Rustic Italian Pizza Dough
recipes.description:
1. In a stand mixer with the paddle, mix flour, sea salt, and yeast on low until combined; add the COLD water.
  2. Switch to the dough hook; mix low 8-10 min. Dough should be smooth and sticky, not sticking to the sides.
  3. If it sticks to the sides, add a little flour; if too dry, add a little water.
  4. Cut into 6 pieces, form rounds, place on an oiled sheet, drizzle with olive oil.
  5. Cover with plastic wrap; rise at room temp 2 hours in a draft-free spot.
  6. Optional: freeze individually, or refrigerate overnight to a couple of days.

recipes.name: Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description:
1. Preheat oven to 425F.
  2. Toss potato chunks with olive oil, salt, pepper, rosemary, and garlic.
  3. Spread on a sheet pan in a single layer.
  4. Roast 35-40 min, flipping once, until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Jasmine Rice
recipes.description:
1. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
  2. Combine rice, broth, butter, and salt; bring to a boil.
  3. Cover, reduce to low, cook 15 min.
  4. Off heat, rest covered 5 min, then fluff.

recipes.name: Garlic Green Beans
recipes.description:
1. Blanch or steam green beans 3-4 min.
  2. Saute garlic in olive oil 30 sec.
  3. Add beans and salt; toss 2 min.
  4. Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Fruit Salad
recipes.description:
1. Wash and cut all the fruit.
  2. Whisk honey with lime juice.
  3. Toss fruit gently with the dressing.
  4. Chill 20 min before serving.

recipes.name: Roasted Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description:
1. Preheat oven to 425F.
  2. Toss sweet potato cubes with oil, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
  3. Spread on a sheet pan.
  4. Roast 25-30 min, stirring once.

recipes.name: Mexican Street Corn
recipes.description:
1. Grill or char the corn ~10 min.
  2. Brush with mayo.
  3. Sprinkle with cotija and chili powder.
  4. Serve with lime wedges.
